notes: Each contract's runtime as forge builds it (solc 0.8.28, contracts/pool-evm/foundry.toml): its length, the keccak256 of the runtime with every immutable's 32 bytes zeroed, and each immutable's start offsets. Written by contracts/pool-evm/script/deploy.mjs --write-build; test/deploy.test.mjs fails when forge's output differs; CI runs it after its forge test, with the forge CI installs (1.7.1). Forge 1.7.1 and 1.8.6 both build these bytes (solc 0.8.28 does the compiling): the test passed on 1.7.1 and the dry run, whose deploy.mjs refuses a build that differs, ran on 1.8.6, 2026-11-03. SellDelegate rebuilt for card evm-sell-v4 (constructor(IWETH, IPoolManager)) with forge 1.7.1, the version CI installs, on 2026-11-04.

SellDelegate.note: The v1 sell delegate (constructor(IWETH), one immutable: WETH), as this file pinned it before e9f6ff9. A deployed contract here has no upgrade path, so its code stays this build. It is checked only at the addresses in `at`, the pool-evm-deploy runs' delegates, which the kit pins until it moves to the evm-sell-v4 delegate; any other address, and every contract a run deploys now, is checked against `contracts`. deploy.mjs --write-build keeps this map as it is.
